name: How do I find a qualified intermediary for a 1031 Exchange in the Miami-Dade area?

mainEntity.name: How do I find a qualified intermediary for a 1031 Exchange in the Miami-Dade area?

acceptedAnswer.text: A qualified intermediary (QI) is essential for a valid 1031 Exchange as they hold the sale proceeds and facilitate the exchange. To find one in Miami-Dade, look for reputable companies specializing in 1031 services. You should verify their experience and ensure they are bonded and insured. It's advisable to engage a QI early in the process, even before listing your relinquished property. While we can assist with identifying suitable replacement properties, we always recommend consulting with a legal or tax professional in addition to selecting a QI to ensure all aspects of your exchange are handled correctly.
